description: Get HUD Income Limits for a county, metro area, or entire state. Shows Very Low, Extremely Low, and Low income thresholds by household size (1-8 persons). Used for affordable housing eligibility.

entity_id.description: County FIPS or CBSA code (get from hud_list_counties)

state.description: State for state-wide income limits: name, two-letter code or FIPS code (e.g. 'Texas', 'TX', '48')

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g. 2024). Defaults to current year.

name: hud_income_limits
